spec.name: prov
formats
wrroc
preview
spec.description: Write a self-contained, offline ro-crate-preview.html with resource charts, a grouped workflow DAG and output lineage beside the Workflow Run RO-Crate (default: false). Requests Nextflow trace metrics and includes observed failed attempts/workflows. Uses the same overwrite policy as the metadata file.

spec.name: license
spec.description: The license for the Workflow Run RO-Crate.

spec.name: agent
ror
spec.description: The ROR of the organization.

spec.description: The contact phone number.

spec.name: name
spec.description: The name of the person or organization.

spec.name: orcid
spec.description: The ORCID of the person.

spec.name: contactType
spec.description: The contact type (e.g. `Researcher`).

spec.name: email
spec.description: The contact email address.
The agent (person) running the workflow.

spec.name: file
spec.description: The file name of the Workflow Run RO-Crate.

spec.name: copyInputs
spec.description: Copy eligible local input files into the RO-Crate (default: true). Set false to retain external input locations and lineage without copying input contents. Does not affect workflow outputs, report assets or explicitly selected sourceFiles snapshots.

spec.name: sourceFiles
spec.description: Explicit project-relative files to snapshot with evidence enabled (default: []). No directories, globs or paths outside the project. Use for relevant local source changes; review these files for secrets.

spec.name: evidence
spec.description: Embed expanded task scripts, resolved task values, execution settings, trace metrics and source identity (default: false). Execution wrappers are not collected. Scripts, values and selected source files may contain sensitive information. Does not copy external reads or reference data.

ror
spec.description: The ROR of the organization.

spec.description: The contact phone number.

spec.name: name
spec.description: The name of the person or organization.

spec.name: orcid
spec.description: The ORCID of the person.

spec.name: contactType
spec.description: The contact type (e.g. `Researcher`).

spec.name: email
spec.description: The contact email address.
The organization of the agent running the workflow.

spec.name: publisher
spec.description: The publisher of the Workflow Run RO-Crate. Must be the ORCID of the agent or the ROR of the organization.

spec.name: codeRepository
spec.description: Absolute HTTP(S) source repository URL without credentials, used when Nextflow did not detect a repository. Does not infer a source revision or change local file packaging.

spec.name: overwrite
spec.description: When `true` overwrites any existing Workflow Run RO-Crate with the same name (default: `false`).
Configuration scope for the WRROC output format.

spec.name: dag
file
spec.description: The file name of the DAG diagram.

spec.name: overwrite
spec.description: When `true` overwrites any existing DAG diagram with the same name (default: `false`).
Configuration scope for the DAG output format.

spec.name: gexf
file
spec.description: The file name of the GEXF file.

spec.name: overwrite
spec.description: When `true` overwrites any existing GEXF file with the same name (default: `false`).
Configuration scope for the GEXF output format.

spec.name: bco
file
spec.description: The file name of the BCO manifest.

spec.name: overwrite
spec.description: When `true` overwrites any existing BCO manifest with the same name (default: `false`).
Configuration scope for the BCO output format.
Configuration scope for the desired output formats.

spec.name: directory
spec.description: The directory where the provenance reports should be saved. The path is resolved against the workflow output directory (`outputDir`). It must be a relative path within the output directory, and it cannot be used when a report file is an absolute path. By default, it is not used and report files are resolved against the launch directory.

spec.name: enabled
spec.description: Create the provenance report (default: `true` if plugin is loaded).
The `prov` scope allows you to configure the `nf-prov-jds` plugin.
